english_description: A weekday with the date library C encoding and its ISO 8601 representation.

queries.english: Whether the stored weekday is within the seven-day encoding range.
The C encoding of this weekday with Sunday represented by zero.
The ISO encoding of this weekday with Sunday represented by seven.

constraints.english: weekday_from_days(z) is the Euclidean remainder of z plus four modulo seven and returns a value from zero through six.
The C encoding uses zero for Sunday and values one through six for Monday through Saturday.
iso_encoding maps C encoding zero to seven and preserves nonzero weekday encodings.

adversary_table.scenario: The epoch day count zero is decoded as a day other than Thursday.
adversary_table.resolution: Return C encoding four for the epoch Thursday.

adversary_table.scenario: Sunday's C encoding zero is returned as ISO encoding zero.
adversary_table.resolution: Return ISO encoding seven for Sunday.

source_references.notes: Pinned weekday-from-days formula, range check, C encoding, and ISO conversion; observed cases are accepted in E-13.
Creusot contracts for weekday_from_days, ok, c_encoding, and iso_encoding.
